title: Add a form of access control to `takeFee`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  `takeFee()` function is available for everyone. Imagine depositors A, B, C, each deposited 10 ETH, and holding 10 shares each, and they have the same debt. Anyone can call `takeFee()` for A and B, decreasing their shares gradually to 9.99.
